local Fluid = require "../roblox_packages/Fluid"

type function Controls(controls: type)
	assert(controls.tag == "table", "expected controls to be a table")
	for key, values in controls:properties() do
		if values.read then controls:setreadproperty(key, types.newfunction({}, { head = { values.read } })) end

		if values.write then controls:setwriteproperty(key, types.newfunction({}, { head = { values.write } })) end
	end
	return controls
end

local function createControlStates(converted: any, controls: any, creator: any)
	local states = {}

	for key, control in pairs(converted) do
		local controlValue = controls[key]

		if control.EntryType == "ControlGroup" then
			states[key] = createControlStates(control.Controls, controlValue, creator)
			continue
		end

		states[key] = creator(controlValue)
	end

	return states
end

local function updateControlStates(states: any, converted: any, controls: any, updater: any)
	for key, control in pairs(converted) do
		local controlValue = controls[key]

		if control.EntryType == "ControlGroup" then
			updateControlStates(states[key], control.Controls, controlValue, updater)
			continue
		end
		updater(states[key], controlValue)
	end
end

local function createFluidStory<C>(storyProps: {
	controls: C,
	render: ({ controls: Controls<C> }) -> Instance,
})
	return {
		controls = storyProps.controls,
		render = function(props)
			return Fluid.root(function()
				const states = createControlStates(
					props.converted,
					props.controls,
					function(value) return Fluid.source(value) end
				)

				props.subscribe(function(values)
					updateControlStates(states, props.converted, values, function(state, value) state(value) end)
				end)

				local rendered = storyProps.render { controls = states :: Controls<C> }
				rendered.Parent = props.target
			end)
		end,
	}
end

return createFluidStory

const useDissolved = require "./useDissolved"
const Fluid = require "../roblox_packages/Fluid"

local function forKeys<KI, KO, V>(values: Fluid.UsedAs<{ [KI]: V }>, map: (KI) -> KO): Fluid.UsedAs<{ [KO]: V }>
	return useDissolved(function(read: useDissolved.Read)
		local result = {}
		for key, value in read<<{ [KI]: V }>>(values) do
			result[map(key)] = value
		end
		return result
	end)
end

return forKeys

const useDissolved = require "./useDissolved"
const Fluid = require "../roblox_packages/Fluid"

local function forPairs<KI, VI, KO, VO>(pairs: Fluid.UsedAs<{ [KI]: VI }>, map: (KI, VI) -> (KO, VO)): Fluid.UsedAs<{ [KO]: VO }>
	return useDissolved(function(read: useDissolved.Read)
		local keys = read(pairs) :: { [KI]: VI }
		local result = {}
		for key, value in keys do
			local newKey, newValue = map(key, value)
			result[newKey] = newValue
		end
		return result
	end)
end

return forPairs

local Fluid = require "../roblox_packages/Fluid"
local useDissolved = require "./useDissolved"

local function forRange<T>(
	map: (index: number) -> T,
	startingIndex: Fluid.UsedAs<number>,
	endingIndex: Fluid.UsedAs<number>,
	step: Fluid.UsedAs<number>?
): Fluid.UsedAs<{ T }>
	return useDissolved(function(read: useDissolved.Read)
		local startingIndex = read<<number>>(startingIndex)
		local endingIndex = read<<number>>(endingIndex)
		local step = read<<number>>(step or 1)

		local result = table.create(endingIndex - startingIndex)
		for index = startingIndex, endingIndex, step do
			result[index] = map(index)
		end

		return result
	end)
end

return forRange

const useDissolved = require "./useDissolved"
const Fluid = require "../roblox_packages/Fluid"

local function forValues<VI, VO>(values: Fluid.UsedAs<{ VI }>, map: (VI) -> VO): Fluid.UsedAs<{ VO }>
	return useDissolved(function(read: useDissolved.Read)
		local values = read(values) :: { VI }
		local result = table.create(#values)
		for index, value in values do
			result[index] = map(value)
		end
		return result
	end)
end

return forValues

local types = require "@self/types"

export type Read = types.Read

return table.freeze {
	useAtom = require "@self/useAtom",
	useCamera = require "@self/useCamera",
	useDelay = require "@self/useDelay",
	useDissolved = require "@self/useDissolved",
	useInterval = require "@self/useInterval",
	useLifetime = require "@self/useLifetime",
	useMotion = require "@self/useMotion",
	useNextOrder = require "@self/useNextOrder",
	useOsClock = require "@self/useOsClock",
	useRem = require "@self/useRem",
	useShow = require "@self/useShow",
	useToggled = require "@self/useToggled",

	forKeys = require "@self/forKeys",
	forPairs = require "@self/forPairs",
	forRange = require "@self/forRange",
	forValues = require "@self/forValues",

	outProperty = require "@self/outProperty",

	createFluidStory = require "@self/createFluidStory",
}

const Fluid = require "../roblox_packages/Fluid"

export type Read = <T>(value: Fluid.UsedAs<T>) -> T

return nil

const Charm = require "../roblox_packages/Charm"
const Fluid = require "../roblox_packages/Fluid"

local function useAtom<T>(atom: Charm.Atom<T>): () -> T
	local source = Fluid.source(atom())
	Fluid.cleanup(Charm.effect(function() Charm.untracked(source, atom()) end))
	return source
end

return useAtom

local Workspace = game:GetService "Workspace"

local Fluid = require "../roblox_packages/Fluid"

local function useCamera()
	local camera = Fluid.source(Workspace.CurrentCamera)
	Fluid.cleanup(Workspace:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CurrentCamera"):Connect(function()
		if Workspace.CurrentCamera then camera(Workspace.CurrentCamera) end
	end))
	return camera
end

return useCamera

local Fluid = require "../roblox_packages/Fluid"

local function useDelay<T>(delaySeconds: Fluid.UsedAs<number>, observed: Fluid.UsedAs<T>): () -> T
	local delayed = Fluid.source(Fluid.read(observed))
	Fluid.effect(function()
		local newObserved = Fluid.read(observed)
		Fluid.cleanup(
			task.delay(
				Fluid.read(delaySeconds),
				function(delayed: typeof(delayed), newObserved: typeof(newObserved)) delayed(newObserved) end,
				delayed,
				newObserved
			)
		)
	end)
	return delayed
end

return useDelay

const Fluid = require "../roblox_packages/Fluid"
const types = require "./types"

local function useDissolved<T>(source: (read: types.Read) -> T): Fluid.UsedAs<T>
	local isDependencyRead = false

	local function mockRead(value: unknown)
		if typeof(value) == "function" then
			isDependencyRead = true
			error "used dependency"
		end
		return value
	end

	local initialSuccess, dissolvedOrError = pcall(source, mockRead :: never)

	return if initialSuccess
		then dissolvedOrError
		elseif isDependencyRead then function() return source(Fluid.read :: never) end
		else error(`Dissolving source threw an error: {dissolvedOrError}`)
end

return useDissolved

local RunService = game:GetService "RunService"

local Fluid = require "../roblox_packages/Fluid"

local function useInterval(seconds: Fluid.UsedAs<number>, callback: () -> (), immediate: boolean?)
	local timer = 0
	local connection = RunService.PreRender:Connect(function(dt)
		timer += dt
		local interval = Fluid.read(seconds)
		if timer >= Fluid.read(seconds) then
			timer -= interval
			callback()
		end
	end)

	local function cleanup() connection:Disconnect() end

	if immediate then Fluid.cleanup(task.spawn(callback)) end

	return cleanup
end

return useInterval

local RunService = game:GetService "RunService"

local Fluid = require "../roblox_packages/Fluid"

local function useLifetime(): () -> number
	local lifetime = Fluid.source(0)
	Fluid.cleanup(RunService.PreRender:Connect(function(dt) lifetime(lifetime() + dt) end))
	return lifetime
end

return useLifetime

local RunService = game:GetService "RunService"

local Fluid = require "../roblox_packages/Fluid"
local Ripple = require "../roblox_packages/Ripple"

local function useMotion<T>(initialValue: T, options: Ripple.MotionOptions?): (() -> T, Ripple.Motion<T>)
	local motion = Ripple.createMotion(initialValue, options)
	local motionValue = Fluid.source(initialValue)

	Fluid.cleanup(RunService.PreRender:Connect(function(dt)
		local value = motion:step(dt)
		motionValue(value)
	end))

	return motionValue, motion
end

return useMotion

local function useNextOrder(index: number?)
	local index = index or 0
	return function()
		index += 1
		return index
	end
end

return useNextOrder

local RunService = game:GetService "RunService"

local Fluid = require "../roblox_packages/Fluid"

local function useOsClock(): () -> number
	local clock = Fluid.source(os.clock())
	Fluid.cleanup(RunService.PreRender:Connect(function(dt) clock(os.clock()) end))
	return clock
end

return useOsClock

local Fluid = require "../roblox_packages/Fluid"
local useCamera = require "./useCamera"

const BASE_REM = 16
const MIN_REM = 10
const BASE_RESOLUTION = Vector2.new(1280, 832)
const DOMINANT_AXIS = 0.5

const Rem = {}
Rem.__index = Rem

export type Rem = setmetatable<{ rem: () -> number }, typeof(Rem)>

function Rem.__call(self: Rem, value: Fluid.UsedAs<number>, mode: Fluid.UsedAs<"scale" | "offset">?)
	return if Fluid.read(mode) == "scale" then self:scale(value) else self:px(value)
end

function Rem.scale(self: Rem, value: Fluid.UsedAs<number>) return Fluid.read(value) * self.rem() / BASE_REM end

function Rem.intoScale(self: Rem, value: Fluid.UsedAs<number>)
	return function() return self:scale(value) end
end

function Rem.px(self: Rem, value: Fluid.UsedAs<number>) return Fluid.read(value) * self.rem() end

function Rem.intoPx(self: Rem, value: Fluid.UsedAs<number>)
	return function() return self:px(value) end
end

function Rem.udim(self: Rem, value: Fluid.UsedAs<number>, mode: Fluid.UsedAs<"scale" | "offset">?): UDim
	return if mode == "scale" then UDim.new(self:scale(value), 0) else UDim.new(0, self:px(value))
end

function Rem.intoUdim(self: Rem, value: Fluid.UsedAs<number>, mode: Fluid.UsedAs<"scale" | "offset">?)
	return function() return self:udim(value, mode) end
end

function Rem.udim2(
	self: Rem,
	x: Fluid.UsedAs<number>,
	y: Fluid.UsedAs<number>,
	mode: Fluid.UsedAs<"scale" | "offset">?
): UDim2
	return if mode == "scale"
		then UDim2.fromScale(self:scale(x), self:scale(y))
		else UDim2.fromOffset(self:px(x), self:px(y))
end

function Rem.intoUdim2(
	self: Rem,
	x: Fluid.UsedAs<number>,
	y: Fluid.UsedAs<number>,
	mode: Fluid.UsedAs<"scale" | "offset">?
)
	return function() return self:udim2(x, y, mode) end
end

local function useRem(): Rem
	local camera = useCamera()

	return setmetatable({
		rem = function()
			local viewport = camera().ViewportSize

			local width = math.log(viewport.X / BASE_RESOLUTION.X, 2)
			local height = math.log(viewport.Y / BASE_RESOLUTION.Y, 2)
			local centered = width + (height - width) * DOMINANT_AXIS

			return math.max(2 ^ centered, MIN_REM)
		end,
	}, Rem)
end

table.freeze(Rem)
return useRem

local Fluid = require "../roblox_packages/Fluid"
local useDissolved = require "./useDissolved"

local function useToggled<T>(
	condition: Fluid.UsedAs<unknown>,
	truthy: Fluid.UsedAs<T>,
	falsy: Fluid.UsedAs<T>
): Fluid.UsedAs<T>
	return useDissolved(function(read) return if read(condition) then read(truthy) else read(falsy) end)
end

return useToggled
